title: 把一次学习，变成可复用的知识
Mathematics for Robotics
summary: These notes cover proofs, linear algebra, and inner product spaces, then use those tools to solve least squares problems, estimate states, and establish when an optimum exists.

title: Chapter 1. Mathematical Arguments
summary: Quantifier order, implications, proof techniques, truth tables, and the distinction between bounds and attained extrema.

title: Chapter 2. Abstract Linear Algebra
summary: Use a polynomial trajectory to work through bases, coordinate changes, eigenvectors, and rank.

title: Chapter 3. Inner Product Spaces and Least Squares
summary: Derive normal equations, weighted fits, minimum-norm solutions, and recursive least squares from projection.

title: Chapter 4. Matrix Factorizations
summary: Choose between QR, SVD, pivoted LU, and Cholesky using worked linear systems and a weakly observed parameter.

title: Chapter 5. Probability, Estimation, and the Kalman Filter
summary: Derive uncertainty-weighted estimates from a sensor model, then predict and update a moving state.

title: Chapter 6. Real Analysis
summary: Distinguish small steps from convergence and use completeness, contraction, and compactness to prove guarantees.

title: Chapter 7. Introduction to Optimization
summary: Compare three calibration fits and formulate their objectives as quadratic or linear programs.
